title: Reduction for Collection Bookings Already Standing on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Return
content:
A reduction is then taken off that window for collection bookings already standing on the same return. Where two or more collection bookings already stand on the return, the second reissue reduction days are taken off. Where exactly one collection booking stands on the return and its last usable day has already passed, the first reissue reduction days are taken off. Where neither holds, nothing is taken off, and the window after the reduction is never less than nothing.

The first reissue reduction days are 3. The second reissue reduction days are 6.

## The ladder as conditions and results

The window in question is the window over which a Northbeam Returns and Restocking collection booking is held open.

| Collection bookings already standing on the return | Their state | Days taken off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| two or more | whatever state they stand in | 6 |
| exactly one | its last usable day has already passed | 3 |
| exactly one | its last usable day has not yet passed | nothing |
| none | — | nothing |

The count is of the collection bookings standing on that return, and the last usable day compared is the last usable day of the booking standing on it.

## Cases on hypothetical inputs

*A return carrying three collection bookings, a window of 17 days before the reduction.* Two or more stand on the return, so 6 days come off and 11 days are left.

*A return carrying one collection booking whose last usable day was yesterday, a window of 13 days before the reduction.* Exactly one stands and its last usable day has passed, so 3 days come off and 10 days are left.

*A return carrying one collection booking whose last usable day is next week, a window of 13 days.* Neither condition holds. Nothing comes off and 13 days are left.

*A return carrying four collection bookings, a window of 4 days before the reduction.* Six days would come off 4, and the window after the reduction is never less than nothing, so nothing is left rather than a negative figure.
